meta.title: Assign a single PR line item to a team member

plan.title: Assign PR Line Item to Team Member

args.goal: On the current Purchase Requisition page, hover over the plus icon in the Assignee column for one unassigned PR line item, click Add Assignee, select an available team member, and stop only when the line item's Assignee column visibly shows the selected team member.

steps.note: Performs the PR-specific assignment interaction and verifies the resulting assignee on screen.
Confirms the resulting line-item table is showing the Assignee column where the assignment was applied.
